On Fri, 2011-05-27 at 00:57 -0700, Juhana Kammonen wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> I am trying to run R-INLA with a besag-model. I have a graph with 3997
> vertices as a single connected component. When executing the
> inla()-function I get:
>
> "
> Error in vector("double", length) : vector size cannot be NA
> In addition: Warning message:
> In inla.read.graph(graph.file) : NAs introduced by coercion
>
> "
>
> Can you tell straight-hand what kind of problem in the graph file
> causes this kind of error? I experimented with your example graph
> files and got no error messages.

sorry for late reply. your message was by the (discussion-group) system
tagged as spam as was put on hold.

can you send me the graph so I can check it? you may also try

inla.debug.graph("file.graph")

which read the graph in a debug-mode with an extensive test of input.
